subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB458. 'Integer-2 shall be non-negative, and shall be equal to or less than the maximum size of data-name-3, as specified in 8.5.1.10' is now screened at bind time in BOTH arms of Format 16 (SIZE OF is a bracket, so the explicit and bare spellings are one format and one bind), against DataItem.DynMaxSize - the 8.5.1.10.1 maximum size, produced once by CobolDynString.MaxSizeOf. Before there was no compile-time screen in either arm and 14.9.39.4 GR37/GR38's clamp stood in for it, so SET SIZE OF D TO 99 over LIMIT IS 8 ran and answered a length of 8 and SET SIZE OF D TO -1 answered 0. GR38 is unconditional for integer-2 precisely BECAUSE SR34 has already guaranteed the literal is in range; the clamp remains the rule for arithmetic-expression-5. docs/CONFORMANCE.md's claim that 'the integer-2 literal form is compile-time bounded by SR34' was false when written and is true in this change set, and now names its code site.
